examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The composer with its disclaimer under it: Enter submits, Shift+Enter adds a line, and the text area grows up to six rows before it scrolls.

examples.name: Streaming
examples.summary: After a submit the Submit control becomes Stop while the response is generated; the reader can keep typing but cannot send until it ends or they stop it.

examples.name: CharacterLimit
examples.summary: A 280-character limit: the counter shows how many are used, and over the limit the frame and counter turn danger and Submit disables.

examples.name: AttachmentsAndActions
examples.summary: An attach control in the toolbar and an attached file shown as a removable chip above the text.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: The composer while the assistant is unavailable: text area, Submit and the toolbar controls are all disabled.
